persona: Shaken and a bit rattled; writes in bursts with exclamation marks but answers questions properly. Has the photo, the glazier's note, the Police confirmation and a note from the joiner saying the quote is not ready.
initial_message: I can't believe this!! Someone broke into our house on Saturday night (the 19th) while we were out at a friend's birthday dinner. They smashed one of the little glass panes in the French doors and levered them open - the frame is all chewed up and the lock is broken. My partner is really shaken. Police have been and a glazier boarded it up, but the joiner can't even give us a quote until he measures the doors. What do we do now??

The frame beside the handle is gouged and the lock is broken. They went through the drawers, but we have not found anything missing.

triage.rationale: The joiner's repair quote is not issued yet (an unavailable notice; the claimant says it comes about a week after the measure on 5 October 2026), so required material is not available yet (evidence_outstanding). No quote, estimate or other amount exists anywhere in the pack and the claimant does not know one, so no amount is known (amount_over_threshold_or_unknown). The photo, the glazier's attendance note and the Police record are in. The doors are boarded and screwed shut, the home habitable, nobody is hurt and no other party is involved, so nothing is complex. Main's theft branch also lists proof of ownership; nothing was taken and the claim is for the building, so the pack treats the photo, the repair quote and the Police record as the required materials. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).
